'
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

FS = 2  # font/linewidth supersampling factor (figure is also scaled by this)

df = dataset.copy()
df.columns = ["Anchor", "Rank", "ShiftLabel", "ShiftDate", "CategoryLabel", "Color", "Hours"]
df["Hours"] = df["Hours"].fillna(0.0)

CAT_ORDER = {"Micro-stops (<2 min)": 0, "Halted (operator wait)": 1,
             "Auto-stops (>2 min)": 2, "Manual stops": 3}

# The report filter context does not always narrow ShiftTrend down to a single
# anchor shift (e.g. the Shift slicer left on "All"), so more than one
# overlapping 4-shift window can arrive in `dataset`. Always resolve to
# exactly one coherent window: the anchor with the most rank coverage
# (prefer a full current+3-prior window), tie-broken by the most recent
# current-shift date.
if df.empty:
    chosen = []
else:
    def _anchor_stats(g):
        rank0 = g.loc[g["Rank"] == 0, "ShiftDate"]
        return pd.Series({
            "n_ranks": g["Rank"].nunique(),
            "date0": rank0.iloc[0] if len(rank0) else "",
        })

    stats = df.groupby("Anchor").apply(_anchor_stats).sort_values(
        ["n_ranks", "date0"], ascending=[False, False]
    )
    df = df[df["Anchor"] == stats.index[0]]

rows = df[["Rank", "ShiftLabel"]].drop_duplicates()
rows = sorted(rows.itertuples(index=False), key=lambda r: -r.Rank)  # oldest first, current last

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(15.6 * FS, 2.75 * FS), dpi=150)  # 1248x220 container aspect ratio

if not rows:
    ax.axis("off")
    ax.text(0.5, 0.5, "No prior-shift data available", ha="center", va="center",
            fontsize=13 * FS, color="#636e72")
else:
    max_hours = df.groupby("Rank")["Hours"].sum().max() or 1.0
    n = len(rows)
    ax.set_xlim(0, max_hours * 1.02)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.5, n - 0.5)
    ax.invert_yaxis()
    ax.axis("off")

    trans = ax.get_yaxis_transform()
    label_x, right_x = -0.02, 1.02

    pending_texts = []
    for i, r in enumerate(rows):
        sub = df[(df["Rank"] == r.Rank) & (df["ShiftLabel"] == r.ShiftLabel)].copy()
        sub["Order"] = sub["CategoryLabel"].map(CAT_ORDER).fillna(9)
        sub = sub.sort_values("Order")
        total = sub["Hours"].sum()
        ax.barh(i, max_hours, height=0.7, color="#f0f1f5", zorder=1, left=0)
        cum = 0.0
        for _, seg in sub.iterrows():
            h = seg["Hours"]
            if h <= 0:
                continue
            ax.barh(i, h, height=0.7, left=cum, color=seg["Color"], zorder=2,
                    edgecolor="white", linewidth=1.2)
            if max_hours > 0 and h / max_hours > 0.06:
                txt = "%.1fh" % h
                t = ax.text(cum + h / 2.0, i, txt, ha="center", va="center",
                            fontsize=9 * FS, color="white", fontweight="600", zorder=3)
                pending_texts.append((t, cum, h))
            cum += h
        weight = "bold" if r.Rank == 0 else "normal"
        label = r.ShiftLabel + (" (current)" if r.Rank == 0 else "")
        ax.text(label_x, i, label, ha="right", va="center", fontsize=10 * FS,
                color="#2d3436", fontweight=weight, transform=trans)
        ax.text(right_x, i, "%.1fh" % total, ha="left", va="center", fontsize=9.5 * FS,
                color="#636e72", transform=trans)

    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.30, right=0.90, top=0.94, bottom=0.20)

    legend_labels = sorted(df["CategoryLabel"].unique(), key=lambda l: CAT_ORDER.get(l, 9))
    color_by_label = df.drop_duplicates("CategoryLabel").set_index("CategoryLabel")["Color"].to_dict()
    handles = [plt.Rectangle((0, 0), 1, 1, color=color_by_label[l]) for l in legend_labels]
    fig.legend(handles, legend_labels, loc="lower center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.55, 0.01),
               ncol=4, frameon=False, fontsize=8.5 * FS, handlelength=1.2, handleheight=1.2)

    # --- text-fit safety net: hide the hours label if it doesn''t fit its segment ---
    fig.canvas.draw()
    renderer = fig.canvas.get_renderer()
    for t, x0, w in pending_texts:
        bar_px = abs(ax.transData.transform((x0 + w, 0))[0] - ax.transData.transform((x0, 0))[0])
        if t.get_window_extent(renderer=renderer).width > bar_px * 0.94:
            t.set_text("")

plt.show()
